title: Cross-Backbone Confirmatory Evaluation
status: FROZEN before the B1/B2 mixture run

context.b0_consistency_audit: V2M_M3_B0_AUDIT_PASS 9/9 checks, max|delta| = 0.0 (bitwise recompute of every B0 artifact)
context.b0_commit_message: Record V2-M3 B0 developmental audit — adaptive mixture collapses toward static mixing

b0_result.headline: AdaptiveMix ~ StaticMix (B0 DEVELOPMENTAL RESULT)
b0_result.fit_collapse: 2 of 3 seeds fitted beta ~ 0.09-0.10 (alpha ~ constant); AdaptiveMix NLL 0.4454 vs StaticMix 0.4455

disclosure.b0_interpretation: B0 does not provide evidence that competition-dependent mixing improves over a fitted static mixture.
b0_forbidden_claims: specialist trade-off is false (the specialist trade-off and mixer effectiveness are distinct questions; the M2.5 trade-off stands)
disclosure.smoke_disclosure: The instrument-validation smoke was completed end-to-end before the confirmatory run (see pre_run_amendments): 1 seed / 100 bootstrap reps / output dir conf/_smoke (deleted afterwards); no confirmatory-scale result exists and no formula, expert, metric, gate or tolerance was edited after the smoke.
disclosure.reason_to_proceed: The confirmatory judgement of V2-M3 was always pre-registered on B1/B2; the B0 developmental set must not cancel the confirmatory run, and a negative confirmatory result is a clean, valuable outcome.

no_b0_driven_redesign.statement: No competition feature, CDF transform, mixing equation, loss, expert definition, static baseline, metric or gate threshold may be modified in response to the B0 developmental results; the confirmatory run executes the frozen protocol as-is.
forbidden_adjustments: adding expert disagreement as a mixer input
adding any MLP or hidden layer
lowering the 0.003 gate because B0 looked flat

experts.E_random: frozen V2-G Phase A R2 (random-only Stats+V2-Semantic logistic, per-backbone/seed; pickle reused verbatim, never retrained)
experts.E_curriculum: fresh 31-d Stats+Semantic logistic trained with the identical M2 curriculum protocol (m={0,2,4} regime-balanced weights, C grid 0.1/1/10, tie 0.002, train-only standardisation, tune-only selection)

competition_index.cdf: per backbone; empirical CDF fitted on that backbone's reliability_train m={0,2,4} rows only

static_control.formula: p_static = (1 - c) p_R + c p_C, c in [0, 1]

frozen_formulas.loss: binary NLL on grounding_correct; L = (1/3)(L_m0 + L_m2 + L_m4), equal weight per regime, fitted on reliability_tune m={0,2,4} only

confirmatory_design.test_cells: frozen K=10 same8 severity cells m in {0,2,4,8} (7410 rows / 1189 images per cell); all five models share exactly the same rows; the row construction is cross-checked against the frozen B0 expb arrays and the candidate indices are hashed into the artifacts
confirmatory_design.per_backbone_fitting: own reliability_train CDF; own reliability_tune mixer; identical architecture and formula; no backbone-specific redesign

frozen_gates.selective_support: at least one of {Macro E-AURC improves >= 3%, Macro RER@50 gain >= 1pp} versus StaticMix; otherwise the result is labelled AUROC-ONLY METHOD SIGNAL

frozen_verdict_rule.otherwise (0 pass, or 1 pass with the ot: ADAPTIVE MIXTURE NOT SUPPORTED -- stop the entire M3 line

required_behavior_reporting: if beta ~ 0 / alpha nearly constant also appears on B1/B2: record explicitly that the soft adaptive mixing mechanism collapses across backbones

diagnostics.oracle_regret: Oracle_m = max(AUROC_R(m), AUROC_C(m)); Regret_m = Oracle_m - AUROC_method(m); diagnostic only
diagnostics.alpha_diagnostics: A mean/median/p10/p90 and alpha mean/median per m
diagnostics.disagreement_exclusion: |p_R - p_C| is never a mixer input
diagnostics.calibration: ECE / Brier / NLL reported; AUROC improvements with clear calibration degradation must be recorded honestly
diagnostics.grounding_invariance: raw grounding scores, argmax and accuracy stay unchanged; the mixture only changes the reliability estimate

anchors.e_random_vs_phase_a: recomputed K5 pooled-test AUROC must equal V2-G Phase A phaseA_summary.csv R2_stats_sem (store tolerance 1e-9: every input loads verbatim from the frozen store + scorer, bitwise-reproducible by construction)
anchors.e_random_vs_dose_response: recomputed m-level R2 AUROC vs V2-G Phase B dose_response.csv auroc_R2 per (seed, level) (re-scoring tolerance 1e-4: V2-G never persisted per-example dose scores; observed float32 re-scoring drift ~3e-07 AUROC, batch-size independent; a wrong row set / model / T / feature pipeline shifts AUROC by >= 1e-3 and is still caught)
anchors.val_stop_check: random C10 re-score of every curriculum row vs the frozen K10 store (A8.4-style)

pre_run_amendments.scope: scripts/run_v2m_m3_conf.py only (no formula / gate / expert / metric change)
pre_run_amendments.change: E_random and E_curriculum inference now call the fitted model objects' own predict_proba (the exact V2-G / M2 code path) instead of a hand-rolled expit logit
pre_run_amendments.reason: the smoke anchor check showed a ~1e-7 AUROC difference (sklearn sigmoid vs scipy expit at ULP level); the model-object path restores bit fidelity against the V2-G artifacts

pre_run_amendments.scope: scripts/run_v2m_m3_conf.py only (no formula / expert / metric / gate change)
pre_run_amendments.change: the single anchor tolerance splits into ANCHOR_STORE_TOL = 1e-9 (Phase A K5 anchor) and ANCHOR_RESCORE_TOL = 1e-4 (Phase B dose-response m-level AUROC anchor, a re-scoring check because V2-G never persisted its per-example dose scores)
pre_run_amendments.reason: even after the entry-1 inference-path fix the dose anchor still failed with a float32 re-scoring residual of ~3e-07 AUROC; a batch-size probe (64/128/256) reproduced the recomputed AUROC exactly while the stored V2-G value differs by that same ~3e-07, i.e. the residual is float32 non-reproducibility of re-scoring, not a pipeline error; this is the same class as the frozen 1e-4 score-level STOP tolerance, whereas 1e-9 would require bitwise reproducibility (which by construction holds only for the store-loaded K5 anchor)

pre_run_amendments.record: instrument-validation smoke (no script / formula / expert / metric / gate change)
pre_run_amendments.change: after the entry-2 tolerance split, the end-to-end smoke (1 seed, 100 bootstrap reps, output dir conf/_smoke, deleted afterwards) completed and produced provisional smoke-scale outputs: b1 seed1 dAUROC(A-S) for m0/2/4/8 = +0.0002 / +0.0006 / +0.0006 / -0.0005 (macro +0.0002, CI [+0.0000, +0.0004]); b2 seed1 = -0.0005 / +0.0001 / +0.0004 / +0.0006 (macro +0.0001, CI [+0.0001, +0.0002]); smoke verdict ADAPTIVE MIXTURE NOT SUPPORTED (0/2)
pre_run_amendments.reason: the final frozen script must be validated end-to-end before the confirmatory run; the smoke used the 1-seed / 100-rep configuration only, produced no confirmatory-scale verdict, and nothing was changed afterwards

stop_rule: ADAPTIVE MIXTURE NOT SUPPORTED stops the entire M3 method line; the specialist trade-off (M2.5) and the LCR no-go results remain the frozen record.
